Dans cet épisode #2 série audiolettre In: In episode #2 of the Inspirata audioletter series, Krystine St-Laurent takes listeners to meet an ancient and precious gesture: scalp massage with oils. A simple, nourishing ritual that calms the mind and echoes the wisdom of natural cycles. Inside: why this practice, still used today, remains a treasure for quieting the mind. How to choose the oil best suited to you (Féminité, Kapha, Vata). An invitation to slow down and turn a Sunday into a true sacred pause. 🎧 Take 5 minutes to listen and let nature guide you.
Dans cet épisode, Krystine explore ces f: In this episode, Krystine explores those year-ends and chapter-ends where we pile up obligations, reviews, and shoulds, letting our energy quietly drain away. Drawing on her own path, she offers a different way of looking at these passages and one concrete gesture: removing at least one piece of the script that no longer looks like who you are today.
Dans cet épisode, Krystine explore la sa: In this episode, Krystine explores the quiet wisdom of the living world: the way nature, the body, and the mind adjust themselves when given the space. A moment to observe, breathe, and remember that balance isn't something you search for, it's something you return to. 🎧 "The living world, the body, nature... always know what to do."
Dans cet épisode, Krystine parle de ce q: In this episode, Krystine talks about what happens when the inner wind takes up too much space: a system in overload, Vata season amplifying everything. She also shares a first simple pearl around the breath, to begin calming the system. For those who want to go further, she introduces the VATA Experience at the end of the episode, a 7-week journey.
Dans cet épisode, Krystine raconte un dé: In this episode, Krystine recounts a start to the year that went against the current: a lost voice, an extended retreat, and period dramas that shake up the way we look at our present pace. Between rest, an ancestral home, and the end of a major cycle, she opens up a reflection on what the body still agrees to carry, and what it now refuses to bring along.
Dans cet épisode, nous explorons le coût: In this episode, we explore the hidden cost of a body pushed too far, the loss of discernment, the deep fatigue, the silent wear, and this essential question: what truly belongs to me, and what am I still carrying without ever having chosen it?

Dans un monde en accélération constante,: In a world in constant acceleration, slowing down becomes essential. Coming back to what sustains us: the breath, the body, living energy.
Dans un monde qui change à chaque second: In a world that changes every second... here, there's no trend to follow.
Dans un monde qui s’emballe, comment ret: In a world that keeps speeding up, how do you find that inner thread that makes you want to get up every morning? In this special episode, Krystine shares her own path, from burnout to Dharma, and reveals why it's about more than passion: it's a living thread that guides and nourishes us.
